modules.AmbientConfig:
-- Pure validation and lifecycle policy; no Roblox or game dependencies.
local Config = {}
local function number(value, low, high)
    return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value >= low and value <= high
end
local function array(value, count, low, high)
    if type(value) ~= "table" or #value ~= count then
        return false
    end
    for key, v in pairs(value) do
        if not number(key, 1, count) or key % 1 ~= 0 or not number(v, low, high) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end
local function sequence(value, width, low, high)
    if type(value) ~= "table" or #value < 2 or #value > 20 then
        return false
    end
    local previous = -1
    for i, point in ipairs(value) do
        if
            not array(point, width, low, high)
            or not number(point[1], 0, 1)
            or point[1] <= previous
        then
            return false
        end
        if (i == 1 and point[1] ~= 0) or (i == #value and point[1] ~= 1) then
            return false
        end
        previous = point[1]
    end
    for key in pairs(value) do
        if not number(key, 1, #value) or key % 1 ~= 0 then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end
function Config.validate(p, schema)
    if type(p) ~= "table" or p.version ~= schema.version then
        return false, "Unsupported ambient version"
    end
    local checks = {
        version = p.version == schema.version,
        name = type(p.name) == "string" and #p.name > 0 and #p.name <= 80,
        origin = array(p.origin, 3, -100000, 100000),
        texture = type(p.texture) == "string"
            and (
                string.match(p.texture, "^rbxasset://") ~= nil
                or string.match(p.texture, "^rbxassetid://%d+$") ~= nil
            ),
        enabled = type(p.enabled) == "boolean",
        rate = number(p.rate, 0, schema.maxRate),
        lifetime = array(p.lifetime, 2, 0.01, schema.maxLifetime),
        speed = array(p.speed, 2, 0, schema.maxSpeed),
        size = sequence(p.size, 2, 0, schema.maxSize),
        transparency = sequence(p.transparency, 2, 0, 1),
        color = sequence(p.color, 4, 0, 255),
        acceleration = array(p.acceleration, 3, -schema.maxAcceleration, schema.maxAcceleration),
        lightEmission = number(p.lightEmission, 0, 1),
        rotation = array(p.rotation, 2, -360, 360),
        rotSpeed = array(p.rotSpeed, 2, -360, 360),
        spread = array(p.spread, 2, 0, 180),
        orientation = table.find(schema.orientations, p.orientation) ~= nil,
        sourceSize = array(p.sourceSize, 3, 0.01, 100),
        distance = array(p.distance, 2, 0, schema.maxDistance),
        reducedMotionScale = number(p.reducedMotionScale, 0, 1),
        burstCount = number(p.burstCount, 0, schema.maxBurst) and p.burstCount % 1 == 0,
        burstCooldown = number(p.burstCooldown, 0.1, 300),
        sources = type(p.sources) == "table" and #p.sources > 0 and #p.sources <= schema.maxSources,
    }
    for key, valid in pairs(checks) do
        if not valid then
            return false, "Invalid ambient " .. key
        end
    end
    for key in pairs(p) do
        if checks[key] == nil then
            return false, "Unknown ambient key " .. tostring(key)
        end
    end
    for _, key in ipairs({ "lifetime", "speed", "rotation", "rotSpeed", "distance" }) do
        if p[key][1] > p[key][2] then
            return false, "Reversed range " .. key
        end
    end
    if p.distance[1] == p.distance[2] then
        return false, "Distance fade requires nonzero span"
    end
    for key, source in pairs(p.sources) do
        if
            not number(key, 1, #p.sources)
            or key % 1 ~= 0
            or not array(source, 3, -10000, 10000)
        then
            return false, "Invalid source"
        end
    end
    if
        #p.sources
            * (p.rate * p.lifetime[2] + p.burstCount * math.ceil(p.lifetime[2] / p.burstCooldown))
        > schema.maxParticles
    then
        return false, "Ambient particle budget exceeded"
    end
    return true
end
function Config.scale(p, schema, distance, quality, reducedMotion)
    local amount = schema.qualities[quality]
    assert(amount ~= nil, "Unknown ambient quality")
    local proximity = math.clamp((p.distance[2] - distance) / (p.distance[2] - p.distance[1]), 0, 1)
    return p.enabled and amount * proximity * (reducedMotion and p.reducedMotionScale or 1) or 0
end
function Config.canBurst(p, running, scale, now, last)
    return running and scale > 0 and p.burstCount > 0 and now - last >= p.burstCooldown
end
return Config
modules.AmbientField:
-- Standalone client-owned ambient field. Caller supplies clock/camera updates;
-- there are no Heartbeat connections, gameplay imports, or server side effects.
local Policy = require(script.Parent.AmbientConfig)
local AmbientField = {}
local function vector(value)
    return Vector3.new(unpack(value))
end
local function curve(value)
    local points = {}
    for _, point in ipairs(value) do
        table.insert(points, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(point[1], point[2]))
    end
    return NumberSequence.new(points)
end
local function copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
        return value
    end
    local result = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do
        result[key] = copy(item)
    end
    return result
end
function AmbientField.create(parent, config, schema)
    local valid, problem = Policy.validate(config, schema)
    assert(valid, problem)
    local p, limits = copy(config), copy(schema)
    local root = Instance.new("Folder")
    root.Name = p.name
    root.Parent = parent
    local emitters, sources = {}, {}
    local colors = {}
    for _, keypoint in ipairs(p.color) do
        table.insert(
            colors,
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(
                keypoint[1],
                Color3.fromRGB(keypoint[2], keypoint[3], keypoint[4])
            )
        )
    end
    for index, position in ipairs(p.sources) do
        local source = Instance.new("Part")
        source.Name = "AmbientSource" .. index
        source.Size = vector(p.sourceSize)
        source.Anchored = true
        source.CanCollide = false
        source.CanTouch = false
        source.CanQuery = false
        source.CastShadow = false
        source.Transparency = 1
        source.Position = vector(p.origin) + vector(position)
        source.Parent = root
        local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
        emitter.Name = "AmbientParticles"
        emitter.Enabled = false
        emitter.Rate = 0
        emitter.Texture = p.texture
        emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(unpack(p.lifetime))
        emitter.Speed = NumberRange.new(unpack(p.speed))
        emitter.Size = curve(p.size)
        emitter.Transparency = curve(p.transparency)
        emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(colors)
        emitter.Acceleration = vector(p.acceleration)
        emitter.LightEmission = p.lightEmission
        emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(unpack(p.rotation))
        emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(unpack(p.rotSpeed))
        emitter.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(unpack(p.spread))
        emitter.Orientation = Enum.ParticleOrientation[p.orientation]
        emitter.Parent = source
        table.insert(emitters, emitter)
        table.insert(sources, source)
    end
    local running, destroyed, scale = false, false, 0
    local lastBurst, clock = -math.huge, 0
    local handle = { root = root }
    function handle:start()
        if not destroyed then
            running = true
        end
    end
    function handle:stop(clear)
        running, scale = false, 0
        if destroyed then
            return
        end
        for _, emitter in ipairs(emitters) do
            emitter.Enabled = false
            emitter.Rate = 0
            if clear then
                emitter:Clear()
            end
        end
    end
    function handle:destroy()
        if destroyed then
            return
        end
        self:stop(true)
        destroyed = true
        root:Destroy()
        table.clear(emitters)
        table.clear(sources)
    end
    function handle:update(dt, cameraPosition, quality, reducedMotion)
        if destroyed then
            return
        end
        if root.Parent == nil then
            self:destroy()
            return
        end
        assert(type(dt) == "number" and dt >= 0 and dt < math.huge, "Invalid ambient delta time")
        clock += dt
        -- Nearest source avoids cutting off a long field by its center alone.
        local distance = math.huge
        for _, source in ipairs(sources) do
            distance = math.min(distance, (cameraPosition - source.Position).Magnitude)
        end
        scale = running and Policy.scale(p, limits, distance, quality, reducedMotion) or 0
        for _, emitter in ipairs(emitters) do
            emitter.Rate = p.rate * scale
            emitter.Enabled = running and scale > 0 and p.rate > 0
            -- Existing particles naturally expire across ordinary distance fades.
            -- Explicit off/reduced-motion suppression takes immediate effect.
            if quality == "off" or (reducedMotion and p.reducedMotionScale == 0) then
                emitter:Clear()
            end
        end
    end
    function handle:burst(sourceIndex)
        if destroyed or not Policy.canBurst(p, running, scale, clock, lastBurst) then
            return false
        end
        local emitter = emitters[sourceIndex]
        if not emitter then
            return false
        end
        local count = math.floor(p.burstCount * scale)
        if count < 1 then
            return false
        end
        emitter:Emit(count)
        lastBurst = clock
        return true
    end
    function handle:status()
        return { running = running, destroyed = destroyed, scale = scale, sources = #sources }
    end
    return handle
end
return AmbientField
modules.RippleTimeline:
-- Pure bounded validation and analytic timing for native Beam rings.
local Timeline = {}
local function finite(n, low, high)
    return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n >= low and n <= high
end
local function vector(value, length, low, high)
    if type(value) ~= "table" or #value ~= length then
        return false
    end
    for key, n in pairs(value) do
        if not finite(key, 1, length) or key % 1 ~= 0 or not finite(n, low, high) then
            return false
        end
    end
    return true
end
function Timeline.validate(p)
    if type(p) ~= "table" then
        return false
    end
    local valid = {
        version = p.version == 1,
        name = type(p.name) == "string" and #p.name > 0 and #p.name <= 80,
        segments = finite(p.segments, 24, 48) and p.segments % 1 == 0,
        poolSize = finite(p.poolSize, 1, 2) and p.poolSize % 1 == 0,
        duration = finite(p.duration, 0.1, 3),
        radius = vector(p.radius, 2, 0.05, 10),
        width = vector(p.width, 2, 0.005, 0.5),
        transparency = vector(p.transparency, 2, 0, 1),
        surfaceOffset = finite(p.surfaceOffset, 0.01, 0.5),
        color = vector(p.color, 3, 0, 255),
        lightEmission = finite(p.lightEmission, 0, 1),
        maxDistance = finite(p.maxDistance, 1, 500),
        minimumInterval = finite(p.minimumInterval, 0.01, 10),
        qualityCapacity = type(p.qualityCapacity) == "table",
        reducedMotionEnabled = type(p.reducedMotionEnabled) == "boolean",
    }
    for _, ok in pairs(valid) do
        if not ok then
            return false
        end
    end
    for key in pairs(p) do
        if valid[key] == nil then
            return false
        end
    end
    if p.radius[1] > p.radius[2] or p.transparency[2] ~= 1 then
        return false
    end
    for _, quality in ipairs({ "full", "reduced", "minimal", "off" }) do
        local count = p.qualityCapacity[quality]
        if not finite(count, 0, p.poolSize) or count % 1 ~= 0 then
            return false
        end
    end
    for key in pairs(p.qualityCapacity) do
        if key ~= "full" and key ~= "reduced" and key ~= "minimal" and key ~= "off" then
            return false
        end
    end
    return p.qualityCapacity.off == 0
end
function Timeline.sample(p, age)
    local t = math.clamp(age / p.duration, 0, 1)
    local expansion = 1 - (1 - t) ^ 2
    return {
        radius = p.radius[1] + (p.radius[2] - p.radius[1]) * expansion,
        width = p.width[1] + (p.width[2] - p.width[1]) * t,
        transparency = p.transparency[1] + (p.transparency[2] - p.transparency[1]) * t,
        complete = age >= p.duration,
    }
end
function Timeline.capacity(p, quality, reducedMotion)
    if reducedMotion and not p.reducedMotionEnabled then
        return 0
    end
    return p.qualityCapacity[quality] or 0
end
function Timeline.chooseSlot(rings, capacity)
    local selected
    for index = 1, math.min(#rings, capacity) do
        local ring = rings[index]
        if not ring.active then
            return index
        end
        if not selected or ring.born < rings[selected].born then
            selected = index
        end
    end
    return selected
end
return Timeline
modules.WaterRipple:
-- Two pooled native ring hosts, no texture asset, physics, timers or service loops.
-- Caller passes actual sampled WATER surface position; this module adds its offset.
local Timeline = require(script.Parent.RippleTimeline)
local WaterRipple = {}
local function copy(value)
    if type(value) ~= "table" then
        return value
    end
    local result = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do
        result[key] = copy(item)
    end
    return result
end
function WaterRipple.create(parent, config)
    assert(Timeline.validate(config), "Invalid water ripple preset")
    local p = copy(config)
    local root = Instance.new("Folder")
    root.Name = p.name
    root.Parent = parent
    local rings = {}
    local clock, lastTrigger, destroyed = 0, -math.huge, false
    for index = 1, p.poolSize do
        local host = Instance.new("Part")
        host.Name = "PooledRing" .. index
        host.Size = Vector3.one
        host.Transparency = 1
        host.Anchored = true
        host.CanCollide, host.CanTouch, host.CanQuery, host.CastShadow = false, false, false, false
        host.Parent = root
        local ring =
            { host = host, attachments = {}, beams = {}, directions = {}, active = false, born = 0 }
        for n = 1, p.segments do
            local theta = (n - 1) * math.pi * 2 / p.segments
            local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
            attachment.Name = "RingPoint" .. n
            attachment.Parent = host
            ring.attachments[n] = attachment
            ring.directions[n] = Vector3.new(math.cos(theta), 0, math.sin(theta))
        end
        for n = 1, p.segments do
            local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
            beam.Name = "RingSegment" .. n
            beam.Attachment0 = ring.attachments[n]
            beam.Attachment1 = ring.attachments[n % p.segments + 1]
            beam.FaceCamera = true
            beam.Segments = 1
            beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(unpack(p.color)))
            beam.LightEmission = p.lightEmission
            beam.Enabled = false
            beam.Parent = host
            ring.beams[n] = beam
        end
        rings[index] = ring
    end
    local function hide(ring)
        ring.active = false
        for _, beam in ipairs(ring.beams) do
            beam.Enabled = false
        end
    end
    local function draw(ring, age)
        local state = Timeline.sample(p, age)
        if state.complete then
            hide(ring)
            return
        end
        for n, attachment in ipairs(ring.attachments) do
            attachment.Position = ring.directions[n] * state.radius
        end
        local alpha = NumberSequence.new(state.transparency)
        for _, beam in ipairs(ring.beams) do
            beam.Width0, beam.Width1 = state.width, state.width
            beam.Transparency = alpha
            beam.Enabled = true
        end
    end
    local handle = { root = root }
    function handle:clear()
        if destroyed then
            return
        end
        for _, ring in ipairs(rings) do
            hide(ring)
        end
    end
    function handle:destroy()
        if destroyed then
            return
        end
        self:clear()
        destroyed = true
        root:Destroy()
        table.clear(rings)
    end
    function handle:trigger(surfacePosition, cameraPosition, quality, reducedMotion)
        if destroyed then
            return false
        end
        if root.Parent == nil then
            self:destroy()
            return false
        end
        local capacity = Timeline.capacity(p, quality, reducedMotion)
        if
            capacity == 0
            or (surfacePosition - cameraPosition).Magnitude > p.maxDistance
            or clock - lastTrigger < p.minimumInterval
        then
            return false
        end
        for index, ring in ipairs(rings) do
            if index > capacity then
                hide(ring)
            end
        end
        local selected = rings[Timeline.chooseSlot(rings, capacity)]
        -- Pool saturation replaces the oldest allowed ring; never allocates more.
        selected.host.Position = surfacePosition + Vector3.new(0, p.surfaceOffset, 0)
        selected.active, selected.born = true, clock
        lastTrigger = clock
        draw(selected, 0)
        return true
    end
    function handle:update(dt, cameraPosition, quality, reducedMotion)
        if destroyed then
            return
        end
        if root.Parent == nil then
            self:destroy()
            return
        end
        assert(type(dt) == "number" and dt >= 0 and dt < math.huge, "Invalid ripple dt")
        clock += dt
        local capacity = Timeline.capacity(p, quality, reducedMotion)
        for index, ring in ipairs(rings) do
            if ring.active then
                if
                    index > capacity
                    or (ring.host.Position - cameraPosition).Magnitude > p.maxDistance
                then
                    hide(ring)
                else
                    draw(ring, clock - ring.born)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    function handle:status()
        local active = 0
        for _, ring in ipairs(rings) do
            if ring.active then
                active += 1
            end
        end
        return { active = active, poolSize = #rings, destroyed = destroyed }
    end
    return handle
end
return WaterRipple
